source.title: Knight Time
source.objective: Collect Remnants of Valor within Naxxramas.
source.progress:
Each slain minion of the Scourge is a soul freed, <name>. Never forget the good you do, even - no, especially when the battle feels hopeless. As long as we stand against him, the Lich King's armies cannot stop us.

I suspect you know the drill by now. Provide me with more remnants, and I will continue to empower your seal.
source.completion:
Justice seeks no reward, <name>.

I know you do, though. Take this.
